title: EOSMAT v4 — native material and scientific evidence
description: Native simplified EOSMAT: one model identifier, parameter annotations beside values, and optional detailed evidence. GPa, kelvin and conventional-cell Å³ are fixed by this version; missing review metadata is unreviewed.

family_id.description: Optional browsing family identifier. No composition or EOS is selected by membership; external family definitions need not be installed.

cell_contents.description: Human-readable definition of the conventional cell used by all record volumes.

formula_units_per_cell.description: Crystallographic Z used to convert conventional-cell volume to formula-molar volume.

datasets.description: Primary experimental datasets used to derive one or more EOS records. Small tables may be embedded as rows; larger tables may use a checksummed relative resource.

eos_records.description: Literature EOS parameterizations for this material and phase; may be empty for a structure-only exchange document.

used_by_eos_records.description: Records using these observations; empty for a standalone supporting dataset without an executable EOS.

pressure_reductions.description: Explicit pressure coordinates for linked EOS records. One declaration per EOS per dataset. Absence is unresolved; all reductions share the dataset observations.

observation_views.description: Explicit source rows and display coordinates per EOS; source tables remain unchanged.

debye_temperature_law.description: Characteristic-temperature relation for MieGruneisenDebye. Omission means integrated_gruneisen; JSON Schema defaults are annotations and do not insert the field.

thermal_pressure_reference.description: Pressure baseline for MieGruneisenDebye or Dewaele2006 (the latter supports reference_temperature and absolute_zero only). reference_temperature subtracts E(V,Tr); reference_isentrope subtracts E(V,Tr*theta(V)/theta0); absolute_zero adds the unreferenced Debye thermal pressure to a 0 K cold curve.

thermal_expansion_law.description: Volumetric expansion law integrated by thermal_reference_state. Omission means constant; linear_temperature means alpha(T)=alpha0+alpha1*T, while linear_reference_temperature means alpha(T)=alpha0+alpha1*(T-Tr); both linear laws require alpha1.

reference_volume_law.description: Reference-volume construction for thermal_reference_state. Omission integrates the selected expansivity; linear_temperature applies V0(T)=V0(Tr)*(1+alpha0*(T-Tr)); berman applies V0(T)=V0(Tr)*(1+alpha0*(T-Tr)+0.5*alpha1*(T-Tr)^2).

bulk_modulus_law.description: AlphaKT reference modulus: linear slope or reference-anchored reciprocal cubic with beta1, beta2, beta3 and dK_dT=0.

zero_point_pressure.description: Dewaele2006 absolute_zero only: add zero-point pressure to a static lattice curve (Finger 1981 Eq. 2). Default omitted.

reference_eos_record.description: Globally unique identifier of the exact reference EOS when that executable record is bundled in the Peritheos material library.

reference_calibration_record.description: Globally unique identifier of an executable non-EOS pressure calibration, such as a ruby R1 scale, bundled in the Peritheos calibration library.

equation_kind.description: Thermodynamic dimensionality or constrained path represented by this EOS record. Omission retains backward-compatible inference for isothermal and thermal records.

volume_basis.description: Common amount of material represented by every V and V0 value. V0 for a transformed branch is the precursor volume containing this amount, not necessarily one precursor conventional cell.

determination_method.description: How this record's EOS parameters were determined: measurements, calculations/theory, or both. Classifies the represented parameterization, including fixed parameters and thermal terms, rather than the entire paper. Comparison-only validation and pressure-calibrant lineage do not change the classification. Omission means unknown for backward compatibility.

record_kind.description: Scientific status of the parameter set. Omission means published for backward compatibility.

derived_from_record.description: EOS record whose equation choices or published fixed parameters form the basis of this derived record.

parameter_error_confidence.description: Two-sided confidence level of reported parameter-error half-widths. Null means the values are standard errors or the source convention is otherwise recorded in notes.

temperature_ref_provenance.description: Explicit nominal room-temperature convention; does not assert a numerical temperature reported by the source.

source_lineage.description: Ordered scientific-fit, parameter-table, implementation, correction, and experimental-context sources contributing to a composite record.
